title: Eisenhower's Farewell Address
description: President Dwight D. Eisenhower's televised farewell to the nation in January 1961. Near the end he warns about the growing influence of the military-industrial complex. Was it a parting shot from a general who knew the inside, or a plain civic warning? Source: Internet Archive. A US government address.

title: JFK on Secret Societies
description: An excerpt from John F. Kennedy's April 27, 1961 address to newspaper publishers, where he calls secrecy and secret societies repugnant in a free society. He was speaking about the press and the Cold War. People still argue about whether he meant more than that. Source: Internet Archive, public domain.

title: Experiments with Uri Geller
description: Film of 1970s laboratory tests on Uri Geller: drawing tests, an instrument trace and metal bending. Researchers and skeptics have argued for decades about what the footage shows. Watch it and decide. Source: Internet Archive, public domain mark.

title: The Report on UFOs: Foreword
description: The foreword to Edward J. Ruppelt's 1956 book. Ruppelt ran the US Air Force's Project Blue Book and is widely credited with popularizing the term UFO. A LibriVox volunteer reading of a public-domain text. Source: Internet Archive.

title: The Report on UFOs: Do They or Don't They?
description: The closing chapter of Edward J. Ruppelt's 1956 book, written by the man who ran Project Blue Book. A LibriVox volunteer reading of a public-domain text. Source: Internet Archive.

title: The Flying Saucers Are Real: Chapter 15
description: A chapter from Donald Keyhoe's 1950 book, which argued that flying saucers were real and that the government knew more than it said. A LibriVox volunteer reading of a public-domain text. Source: Internet Archive.

title: The Flying Saucers Are Real: Chapter 20
description: The final chapter of Donald Keyhoe's 1950 book on flying saucers. A LibriVox volunteer reading of a public-domain text. Source: Internet Archive.
